'''Winterfinch''' is a horse owned by [[Beonin Marinye]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Winterfinch|WF}}

==Appearance==
Winterfinch is a stocky brown mare with considerable endurance.{{ref||WF}} She is not very fast.

==Activities==
Winterfinch carries Beonin to [[Tar Valon]] and the [[White Tower]] through a [[gateway]] from the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] camp. Both Beonin and [[Tervail Dura]], riding [[Hammer (horse)|Hammer]], were sneaking back to the Tower after [[Egwene al'Vere]] had been captured.{{ref/book|11|2}}
